posts.title: Assassin is finished!
posts.description: On Wednesday, at 8:53 PM, I finished the first draft of Assassin. It clocked in at just over 97,000 words, making it the biggest book in the Drovers series. Prey was 73,000 words, Outlaws 68,000, and Sura 84,000. More importantly, Assassin finishes the story arc that began with Prey. I may return to Ferran and...
